note: Everything in this file is derived from wrangler.jsonc/src/index.js in THIS repo checkout, verifiable by any future reader by re-running the export script. Fields the repo cannot itself verify (real Cloudflare Dashboard state) are explicitly marked unverified, never guessed.

cron.note: UTC in Cloudflare config; PBS runs every tick; TDX further gated inside scheduled handler to every 2nd tick (minute 00/20/40) and 08:00-21:59:59 Asia/Taipei only (src/traffic/tdxSchedule.js). Declared schedule from wrangler.jsonc -- verified from repo; the REAL Cloudflare Cron Trigger config is dashboard-only and not verifiable from here.

bindings.secretsNote: Names only -- never values. Presence-only verifiable via GET /admin/deployment-status; correctness of any value is never verifiable from code.

public.note: Shared Traffic Feed consumer read path
opaque 128-bit id, 15-min TTL enforced in code

routes.adminAuth: HTTP Basic, fixed username 'admin', Cloudflare Secret ADMIN_PASSWORD, timing-safe SHA-256 comparison (src/security/adminAuth.js)

deployment.method: push to main -> Cloudflare Workers Builds auto-deploy
